description: This Java class 'BillingAccountWorker' provides utility methods for managing billing accounts within the OFBiz framework, including retrieving account balances, open orders, and calculating available balances.

classes.name: BillingAccountWorker
classes.description: Utility class with static methods for billing account operations within OFBiz.

classes.name: BillingAccountComparator
classes.description: Comparator for sorting billing accounts by account balance.

methods.name: makePartyBillingAccountList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of billing accounts related to a party, filtered by currency and role.

methods.name: getBillingAccountOpenOrders
methods.description: Returns a list of open orders associated with a billing account.

methods.name: getBillingAccountAvailableBalance
methods.description: Calculates the available balance for a billing account, considering account limit and current balance.

methods.name: getBillingAccountNetBalance
methods.description: Calculates the net balance of a billing account based on applied payments and invoices.

methods.name: availableToCapture
methods.description: Returns the amount that can still be captured from a billing account.

methods.name: calcBillingAccountBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns billing account balance details, including account balance, net balance, and available amounts.
